autoContext: Validates shell action. Covers: command param (plain string), timeout param (int seconds), variable substitution ({var} from previous_data via _SafeMap), whitelisted commands (date, echo, hostname, whoami, uname), and blocked command rejection.

basic_commands._comment: PARAM: command — plain shell command. echo is whitelisted.
PARAM: command — date with format string. date is whitelisted.
PARAM: command — hostname is whitelisted for system info.

variable_substitution._comment: PARAM: command with {variable} — resolved from previous_data via _SafeMap. Injection chars are stripped from values before substitution.
PARAM: {timestamp} — value from previous step, substituted into this command.

custom_timeout._comment: PARAM: timeout — int seconds before the command is killed. Default is 30. Here set to 3.

compound_command._comment: PARAM: command with && — each executable segment is whitelist-checked independently.
